title: Sandtrapped
meta_description: Find the perfect Miramar Beach, FL vacation rental at “Sandtrapped”, a luxury 7-bed, 7.5-bath vacation rental. Ideal for 16 guests, this home offers a Private Pool & Spa, Game Room, Rooftop Deck & Elevator. Book your memorable stay now!
description_expanded: Home Highlights - Private Resort Style Pool with Hot Tub (Pool can be heated for an additional $70 per day between Oct 1 - May 1) - Elevator - Game Room - Short Walk to the Beach Access - 6 Adult Bikes Included Your Own Private Oasis Nestled in the heart of Miramar Beach, Sandtrapped is a true haven for those seeking the perfect blend of coastal charm and modern luxury. This beach cottage is your gateway to the scenic beach roads, charming surf shops, fabulous dining, chic beachfront houses, and unparalleled views of the Gulf of Mexico. Miramar Beach, one of South Walton’s most vibrant and diverse beach neighborhoods, invites you to experience a world of excitement and relaxation. This exquisite luxury property offers a truly exceptional living experience. The first level features a spacious half bathroom, a king-sized master bedroom, and a master bathroom featuring a walk-in shower and a single vanity. This home prioritizes comfort and style. The open-concept design is enhanced by beautiful warm wood plank Luxury Vinyl Plank (LPV) flooring that grounds the space, creating a light and airy atmosphere. Aspiring chefs will adore the well-appointed kitchen, complete with stainless steel appliances, a gas range, and a custom hood. Ample pantry and storage closet space ensure that organization is effortless. The living room boasts a sleek modern fireplace and floods of natural light through expansive sliding doors that lead to the pool area. Step outside to discover an outdoor kitchen with a dining and seating area, complete with a TV, a sparkling pool, and a relaxing hot tub with Aqualink technology. Additionally, the dining area comfortably seats ten at the table, and four bar stools provide additional seating options. This property is a true masterpiece of luxury living. On the second level, guests will find a fabulous king-sized bedroom, complete with a balcony and stunning pool views - a true oasis. Its ensuite bathroom features a stand-alone tub, a walk in shower, and two elegant vanities, perfect for pampering oneself in style. Another king-sized bedroom, also with a balcony and pool views, ensures that every morning begins with a breathtaking sight. Its bathroom boasts a spacious walk-in shower and two vanities for added convenience. For those moments of relaxation and entertainment, a wet bar awaits, complete with a wine cooler and a sink, making it an ideal spot for entertaining guests. Even a bedroom without a view doesn’t compromise on luxury. Its ensuite bathroom features a walk-in shower and a single vanity, maintaining the property’s lofty standards throughout. Practicality meets opulence with a massive laundry room, equipped with two stacked washer and dryer sets, sinks, ample folding space, and another sink for added convenience. The final king-sized bedroom, located at the front of the house, has its own balcony for a more private retreat. Its ensuite bathroom features a walk-in shower and a single vanity, rounding out the exceptional offerings of this luxury property. The extraordinary top-level retreat defines indulgence and leisure. As you ascend the staircase, you’ll be greeted by an expansive game and living room, complete with a pristine pool table and stunning sliders that open onto the top-level deck. The wet bar is a masterpiece of design, featuring high-top seating, a convenient mini fridge, and a sleek sink for all your entertainment needs. A full bathroom, elegantly appointed, is shared with the adjacent bunk room and common area. This bathroom boasts a connected tub and shower and a single vanity for added convenience. The bunk room itself is a haven of comfort, offering two twin-over-twin bunks, perfect for accommodating guests or family. Meanwhile, a queen bedroom awaits, featuring its own luxurious bath with a walk-in shower, exuding modern elegance. This top-level sanctuary embodies the epitome of luxury living, providing both comfort and sophistication. In conclusion, Sandtrapped stands as a shining example of coastal elegance and modern luxury in the heart of Miramar Beach. Nestled amidst the scenic beach roads, this beach cottage offers a remarkable blend of relaxation and adventure. From the private resort-style pool with a hot tub to the game room and the convenience of an elevator, every detail has been meticulously designed to ensure your stay is nothing short of exceptional. Sandtrapped isn’t just a place to stay; it’s an experience. Book your escape today and discover the magic of coastal living at its finest. Your journey to relaxation, adventure, and Gulf Coast beauty begins here. Sleeping Arrangements First Floor King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Half Bathroom Second Floor Master King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower /Tub Separate King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only King Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only Third Floor 2 Twin/Twin Bunk Room w/ Shared Bathroom, Shower/Tub combo Queen Bedroom w/ Private Bathroom, Shower Only *This home is pet-friendly, if approved, and with the addition of pet fees*
